name: Commune of Padua (podestà and councils)
note: collective government, no single ruler; Jacopo da Carrara elected lord (signore) in 1318

name: Jacopo I the Great da Carrara
note: de jure abdicated Nov 1319 in favour of imperial vicars, de facto in control until death; end given as 22/23 November 1324

name: Marsilio da Carrara
note: 1328-1337 formally vicar of Cangrande I della Scala

name: Jacopino da Carrara
note: co-ruler with his nephew Francesco I

name: Francesco I il Vecchio da Carrara
note: co-ruler with Jacopino until 1355; forced to abdicate by Gian Galeazzo Visconti

name: Francesco II il Novello da Carrara
Francesco II il Novello da Carrara
note: defeated by Venice in the War of Padua; Padua annexed by Venice; executed 1406
